display_long_description:
# JOIN THE #1 PICKLEBALL GAME IN VR
Now with **JOOLA Paddles!** Pickleball One brings the world’s fastest-growing sport into VR with immersive courts, realistic physics, and exciting multiplayer action - including Open Play. 


Features :

● 🎮 Multiplayer ( Singles, Doubles, Skinny Singles)

[media]

● 🌍 **Open Play** – 🎾 Jump into continuous, rotating matches where winners stay on and challengers keep coming. 🔥 Exclusive to Pickleball One!

● 🏆 **Play & Earn XP Points** – 🎮 Play matches, 🏆 earn XP, and 🎁 unlock new rewards. 💥 Every rally pushes you closer to the top.

[media]

● 💪 **Training & Fitness** – 🎯 Sharpen your skills with fitness drills and practice modes.
💪 Stay active, 🔥 burn calories, and 🎮 turn play into a workout.

[media]

● 🥽 **Mixed Reality Mode** – 🏠 Transform your real space into a pickleball court.
🥽 Experience the most immersive and 🎾 realistic rallies in VR.

[media]

Join our community and become a pickleball legend with Pickleball One in VR.
